name: Trigger Editor
description: GUI triggers (war3map.wtg) and custom script (war3map.wct): the tree of categories, triggers and variables, names, flags, comments, undo and saving. What a trigger contains is shown by trigger kinds from other extensions (service w3.triggers).

mcpTools.name: list_triggers
mcpTools.description: The open map's triggers by category, each marked gui or script, and optionally its variables.

mcpTools.name: get_trigger
mcpTools.description: One trigger in full: its events, conditions and actions as the World Editor words them, or its script.

services.description: Trigger kinds (GUI, custom script, …) shown in the trigger editor: registerKind.
